words.enDefinition: a local pharmacy serving people in the surrounding area

examples.en: The clinic sent my prescription to the community pharmacy near our bus stop.
examples.zh: 学校诊所把处方发到了公交站附近的「社区药房」。

examples.en: I called the community pharmacy to check whether their counter stayed open at lunchtime.
examples.zh: 我给「社区药房」打电话，问他们的柜台午休时间开不开。

collocations: collect medicine from a community pharmacy

words.enDefinition: a pharmacy located on university grounds for campus users

examples.en: The campus pharmacy is across from the student clinic in the same building.
examples.zh: 「校园药房」在学生诊所对面，都在同一栋楼里。

examples.en: I asked if the campus pharmacy would still be open after my afternoon lab.
examples.zh: 我问下午的实验课结束后，「校园药房」是否还营业。

collocations: a prescription at the campus pharmacy

words.enDefinition: a place where medicines are prepared and handed out

examples.en: The nurse pointed me to the dispensary on the ground floor of the clinic.
examples.zh: 护士指了指诊所一楼的「配药室」，让我去那里。

examples.en: The dispensary had a separate window for people whose prescriptions were already ready.
examples.zh: 「配药室」有一个专用窗口，给已经配好药的人取药。

words.enDefinition: a trained worker who helps pharmacists prepare and process orders

examples.en: The pharmacy technician checked my name and asked me to wait for the pharmacist.
examples.zh: 「药房技术员」核对了我的姓名，请我等药师过来。

examples.en: I handed the collection slip to the pharmacy technician at the window near the entrance.
examples.zh: 我把取药单交给了入口附近窗口的「药房技术员」。

words.enDefinition: the pharmacist responsible for the pharmacy during a shift

examples.en: The duty pharmacist came over when I asked someone to explain the label.
examples.zh: 我请人解释标签时，「值班药师」走了过来。

examples.en: I left a message for the duty pharmacist because she was helping another customer.
examples.zh: 「值班药师」正在帮另一位顾客，我便给她留了言。

words.enDefinition: a worker who helps with routine tasks in a pharmacy

examples.en: The pharmacy assistant found my order and then called the pharmacist to answer my question.
examples.zh: 「药房助理」找到了我的订单，然后请药师来回答我的问题。

examples.en: I asked the pharmacy assistant where I should wait after checking in on the screen.
examples.zh: 我在屏幕上登记后，问「药房助理」应该在哪里等。

collocations: a pharmacy assistant at the counter

words.enDefinition: a private room for talking with a healthcare professional

examples.en: The pharmacist offered to talk in the consultation room away from the busy queue.
examples.zh: 药师提出到「咨询室」聊，避开排队的人群。

examples.en: There was a sign for the consultation room next to the pharmacy's back counter.
examples.zh: 药房后面那个柜台旁边有一块「咨询室」的指示牌。

words.enDefinition: a place at a pharmacy where patients hand in orders

examples.en: I took my paper order to the prescription drop-off rather than joining the pickup line.
examples.zh: 我把纸质处方拿到「处方提交处」，没有排进取药的队伍。

examples.en: The prescription drop-off was near the entrance with a sign above the counter.
examples.zh: 「处方提交处」在入口附近，柜台上方挂了标牌。

words.enDefinition: the process of collecting medicine prepared for a patient

examples.en: I chose prescription pickup after class because the pharmacy was on my way home.
examples.zh: 药房就在回家路上，所以我选了下课后「领取处方药」。

examples.en: The app showed that prescription pickup was available from the window beside the entrance.
examples.zh: 应用显示，可以到入口旁边的窗口「领取处方药」。

words.enDefinition: the times when a pharmacy is open to customers

examples.en: I checked the pharmacy opening hours before walking over from the university library.
examples.zh: 从学校图书馆走过去之前，我查了「药房营业时间」。

examples.en: The clinic's website lists the pharmacy opening hours for weekends and public holidays separately.
examples.zh: 诊所网站单独列出了周末和公共假期的「药房营业时间」。

words.zhGloss: 非通常时段营业的药房
words.enDefinition: a pharmacy open outside the usual business hours
acceptedZhAnswers: 非通常时段营业的药房

examples.en: My flatmate found an out-of-hours pharmacy near the station after the local one closed.
examples.zh: 附近那家关门后，室友在车站边找到一家「非通常时段营业的药房」。

examples.en: The clinic gave me a list of places including an out-of-hours pharmacy across town.
examples.zh: 诊所给了我一份名单，其中有一家在城另一边「非通常时段营业的药房」。

words.enDefinition: a service that brings pharmacy orders to an address

examples.en: I asked about pharmacy delivery because I would be away from campus that week.
examples.zh: 那周我不在学校，就问了有没有「药房配送」服务。

examples.en: My housemate confirmed the address before we set up pharmacy delivery for Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们约周五下午「药房配送」之前，室友先核对了地址。

words.enDefinition: a pharmacy that ships medicines to customers by post

examples.en: I checked whether the mail-order pharmacy could deliver to my student residence during term.
examples.zh: 我查了「邮寄药房」能不能在学期内送到我的学生宿舍。

examples.en: My clinic asked whether I used a local pharmacy or a mail-order pharmacy.
examples.zh: 诊所问我用的是本地药房，还是「邮寄药房」。

words.enDefinition: collect medicine prepared by a pharmacy for an order

examples.en: I went across campus to pick up a prescription after the pharmacy sent me a text.
examples.zh: 收到药房的短信后，我穿过校园去「领取处方药」。

examples.en: Can I pick up a prescription on Saturday if I can't get there before closing today?
examples.zh: 我今天关门前要是赶不过去，周六能「领取处方药」吗？

collocations: pick up a prescription in person
pick up a prescription after work
arrange to pick up a prescription

words.enDefinition: leave a written order with a pharmacy to prepare

examples.en: I stopped at the pharmacy to drop off a prescription on my way to the library.
examples.zh: 我去图书馆的路上顺道去了药房，「提交纸质处方」。

examples.en: The clinic told me where I could drop off a prescription before I went home.
examples.zh: 回家前，诊所告诉我可以到哪里「提交纸质处方」。

collocations: drop off a prescription in person
drop off a prescription before class
a place to drop off a prescription

words.enDefinition: prepare and supply medicine listed on a prescription

examples.en: I called ahead to ask if the pharmacy could fill a prescription before my evening class.
examples.zh: 我提前打电话，问药房能不能在我晚上上课前「按处方配药」。

examples.en: The new pharmacy needed my details before it could fill a prescription in its system.
examples.zh: 新药房得先录入我的信息，才能在系统里「按处方配药」。

collocations: the pharmacy can fill a prescription

words.enDefinition: prepare and give out medicine as authorized for a patient

examples.en: I asked which counter was used to dispense medication for patients from the clinic.
examples.zh: 我问哪个柜台是给诊所患者「调剂发药」用的。

examples.en: The hospital has a separate team to dispense medication for people going home that day.
examples.zh: 医院有个单独的团队，为当天出院的人「调剂发药」。

words.enDefinition: move a prescription record from one pharmacy to another

examples.en: I asked whether I could transfer a prescription after moving closer to a different pharmacy.
examples.zh: 我搬到离另一家药房更近的地方后，问能不能「转移处方」。

examples.en: The pharmacist explained what details she needed to transfer a prescription from my previous pharmacy.
examples.zh: 药师说明，从原来的药房「转移处方」需要我提供哪些信息。

words.enDefinition: a conversation with a pharmacist about a medicine or question

examples.en: I booked a pharmacist consultation because I had several questions about the new leaflet.
examples.zh: 我对新说明书有几个疑问，于是预约了「药师咨询」。

examples.en: The pharmacist consultation took place in a small room away from the main counter.
examples.zh: 「药师咨询」在一间远离主柜台的小房间里进行。

words.enDefinition: a pharmacy charge for preparing and supplying a prescription

examples.en: The receipt showed a dispensing fee below the price of the medicine itself.
examples.zh: 收据在药品价格下面另列了一笔「配药服务费」。

examples.en: I asked whether the dispensing fee was already included in the total on the screen.
examples.zh: 我问屏幕上显示的总额是否已经包含「配药服务费」。

words.enDefinition: a prescription presented as a printed or handwritten document

examples.en: The doctor handed me a paper prescription to take to the pharmacy across the street.
examples.zh: 医生给了我一张「纸质处方」，让我带到街对面的药房。

examples.en: I folded the paper prescription into my notebook after leaving the campus clinic that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午离开校园诊所时，我把「纸质处方」折好夹进了笔记本。

words.enDefinition: a medicine order created and transmitted in digital form

examples.en: I asked which pharmacy would receive the electronic prescription before leaving the clinic.
examples.zh: 离开诊所前，我问了这张「电子处方」会发到哪家药房。

examples.en: The pharmacist found my electronic prescription while I waited at the collection window.
examples.zh: 我在取药窗口等着的时候，药师找到了我的「电子处方」。

words.enDefinition: a reference code that identifies a specific prescription order

examples.en: The phone recording asked for the prescription number printed near the top of my label.
examples.zh: 电话录音提示我输入标签靠上位置印着的「处方编号」。

examples.en: I used my prescription number to track the order in the pharmacy's app.
examples.zh: 我用「处方编号」在药房的应用里查询订单进度。

words.enDefinition: a healthcare professional authorized to write medicine orders

examples.en: The pharmacist wanted to speak to the prescriber before preparing my order.
examples.zh: 药师想在配药前先跟「处方开具者」沟通。

examples.en: My prescriber answered a message from the pharmacy while I waited at the clinic.
examples.zh: 我在诊所等的时候，我的「处方开具者」回复了药房的消息。

words.enDefinition: a medication order authenticated by the person who issued it

examples.en: I left the clinic with a signed prescription and a note about the pharmacy's location.
examples.zh: 我离开诊所时带着一张「已签署的处方」，还有一张写着药房位置的便条。

examples.en: The receptionist gave me the signed prescription after checking that it belonged to me.
examples.zh: 前台确认是我的之后，把「已签署的处方」交给了我。

words.enDefinition: a pharmacy label identifying a medicine and providing patient-specific details

examples.en: I checked my name on the prescription label before leaving the pharmacy that evening.
examples.zh: 那天傍晚离开药房前，我核对了「处方药标签」上的姓名。

examples.en: Could you show me which line of the prescription label contains the medicine's name?
examples.zh: 能不能指给我看，「处方药标签」上的哪一行是药名？

collocations: the name on the prescription label

words.enDefinition: stored details of a prescription in a pharmacy or clinic system

examples.en: The pharmacist opened my prescription record to look up the order from last month.
examples.zh: 药师打开我的「处方记录」，查询上个月的药品订单。

examples.en: I asked how to request a copy of the prescription record for my own files.
examples.zh: 我问怎样申请一份「处方记录」副本，以便自己留存。

collocations: keep a copy of the prescription record

words.enDefinition: a pharmacy bag containing medicines prepared for a patient

examples.en: The prescription bag had a printed label with my name and the collection date.
examples.zh: 「处方药外袋」上贴着印有我姓名和取药日期的标签。

examples.en: I noticed a leaflet inside the prescription bag after I got back to residence.
examples.zh: 回到宿舍后，我发现「处方药外袋」里面有一张说明书。

words.enDefinition: the date after which a prescription is no longer valid

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist to point out the prescription expiry date on the paper order.
examples.zh: 我请药师指给我看，纸质处方上的「处方失效日期」在哪里。

examples.en: The prescription expiry date was shown next to the clinic name in the online record.
examples.zh: 网上记录里，「处方失效日期」显示在诊所名称旁边。

collocations: ask about the prescription expiry date

words.enDefinition: issuing a new prescription when the previous one ends

examples.en: The pharmacist told me to ask the clinic about a prescription renewal before the holiday.
examples.zh: 药师让我放假前向诊所询问能否「续开处方」。

examples.en: I checked the clinic's website for the form used to request a prescription renewal.
examples.zh: 我去诊所网站找了找用来申请「续开处方」的表格。

words.enDefinition: a request for another supply under an existing prescription

examples.en: My refill request showed up in the app after I confirmed my current pharmacy.
examples.zh: 我确认了现在的药房后，「处方药续配申请」出现在应用里。

examples.en: I called to ask whether the clinic had received my refill request on Monday.
examples.zh: 我打电话问诊所，周一有没有收到我的「处方药续配申请」。

words.enDefinition: the number of further supplies still authorized on a prescription

examples.en: I couldn't find the refills remaining field, so I asked the pharmacy assistant.
examples.zh: 我没找到「剩余续配次数」一栏，就问了药房助理。

examples.en: The pharmacist showed me where my refills remaining appeared in the app on screen.
examples.zh: 药师在屏幕上指给我看，应用里哪里显示我的「剩余续配次数」。

words.enDefinition: a UK prescription arrangement for requesting ongoing medicine again

examples.en: The GP explained where to request a repeat prescription through the NHS app.
examples.zh: 全科医生给我指了在 NHS 应用里到哪里申请「长期用药重复处方」。

examples.en: I asked the clinic to send the repeat prescription to the pharmacy near my hall.
examples.zh: 我请诊所把「长期用药重复处方」发到宿舍附近的药房。

words.enDefinition: dispensing planned supplies in stages under one repeat authorization

examples.en: The pharmacist explained repeat dispensing after the GP mentioned it during my review.
examples.zh: 全科医生在复查时提起过「按同一授权分次配药」，药师后来解释了这个词。

examples.en: I asked the clinic whether it had set up repeat dispensing for my prescription.
examples.zh: 我问诊所，我这份处方有没有安排「按同一授权分次配药」。

words.enDefinition: supplying only part of the quantity authorized on a prescription

examples.en: The receipt showed a partial fill, so I asked the pharmacist about the remaining items.
examples.zh: 收据上写的是「部分配药」，所以我向药师问了剩下的药。

examples.en: The pharmacist called about a partial fill after checking what the shop had available.
examples.zh: 药师确认店里的库存后，打电话和我说了「部分配药」的事。

words.enDefinition: an order intended for one dispensing without authorized refills

examples.en: The receptionist explained that this was a one-time prescription when I asked about refills.
examples.zh: 我问能否续配时，前台解释说这是「单次处方」。

examples.en: My app listed the one-time prescription separately from orders that still had refills available.
examples.zh: 我的应用把「单次处方」和还有续配次数的处方分开显示。

words.enDefinition: an order placed for something not normally carried in stock

examples.en: The pharmacy offered to place a special order because it didn't usually carry that brand.
examples.zh: 药房平时没有那个牌子，就提出可以「特别订货」。

examples.en: I asked when the special order would arrive before making another trip to the shop.
examples.zh: 再次去药房之前，我先问了「特别订货」什么时候到。

words.enDefinition: incorrect information on an order that needs to be checked

examples.en: The pharmacist spotted a prescription error and contacted the clinic before giving me anything.
examples.zh: 药师发现了「处方错误」，先联系诊所，没有把药交给我。

examples.en: I asked the clinic who could check the possible prescription error shown on screen.
examples.zh: 我问诊所，屏幕上显示的疑似「处方错误」可以由谁核查。

words.enDefinition: a written order that is too difficult to read

examples.en: The pharmacist called the clinic to clarify an illegible prescription before preparing the order.
examples.zh: 药师先打电话给诊所核实那张「字迹难辨的处方」，之后才配药。

examples.en: The clinic replaced the illegible prescription with a clearly printed copy that afternoon.
examples.zh: 诊所当天下午把「字迹难辨的处方」换成了一张打印清晰的副本。

words.enDefinition: withdraw an issued medication order before it is filled

examples.en: I called the clinic to cancel a prescription that had been sent to the wrong branch.
examples.zh: 我给诊所打电话，请他们「取消发错分店的处方」。

examples.en: The pharmacist asked who could cancel a prescription if an old order was still active.
examples.zh: 如果旧处方仍然有效，药师想知道谁能「取消处方」。

collocations: the clinic can cancel a prescription
a reason to cancel a prescription

words.enDefinition: dispensing an equivalent generic instead of a prescribed brand

examples.en: I asked about generic substitution when the box had a different name from my prescription.
examples.zh: 药盒名称和处方上不一样，我便问了「仿制药替换」是怎么回事。

examples.en: The pharmacist explained generic substitution before asking me to review the new package label.
examples.zh: 药师先解释了「仿制药替换」，再请我核对新包装上的标签。

words.enDefinition: medicine sold under a manufacturer's distinctive commercial name

examples.en: I asked whether the brand-name medicine was listed under a different name on the receipt.
examples.zh: 我问这款「品牌药」在收据上是不是用了不同的名称。

examples.en: The pharmacist showed me where the brand-name medicine was named on the clinic's electronic order.
examples.zh: 药师给我指了诊所的电子处方上注明这款「品牌药」名称的位置。

collocations: compare a brand-name medicine with a generic

words.enDefinition: a medicine equivalent to a reference brand-name product

examples.en: The pharmacist explained why the generic medicine came in a different box this month.
examples.zh: 药师解释了这个月「仿制药」为何换了个盒子。

examples.en: I checked the name of the generic medicine in the pharmacy's app after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我在药房应用里查了「仿制药」的名称。

words.enDefinition: a substance that produces the intended effect of a medicine

examples.en: The pharmacist pointed out the active ingredient on the side panel of both boxes.
examples.zh: 药师给我指了两个盒子侧面板上的「活性成分」。

examples.en: I asked whether the active ingredient had a different name on the second label.
examples.zh: 我问第二张标签上的「活性成分」是不是用了别的名称。

words.enDefinition: a component of a medicine other than its active substance

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist to identify an inactive ingredient I didn't recognize on the label.
examples.zh: 标签上有一种「非活性成分」我没见过，就请药师认一下。

examples.en: The pharmacist checked whether the inactive ingredient was present in both products on the shelf.
examples.zh: 药师查了架子上两款药品是否都含有这种「非活性成分」。

words.enDefinition: a medicine that requires an authorized prescription to obtain

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist whether the product I had written down was a prescription-only medicine.
examples.zh: 我问药师，我记下名字的这种产品是不是「处方药」。

examples.en: The receipt listed a prescription-only medicine that the clinic had ordered for me.
examples.zh: 收据上列着诊所给我开的「处方药」。

words.enDefinition: a nonprescription medicine supplied through a pharmacy under professional supervision

examples.en: A British pharmacist explained why the pharmacy-only medicine wasn't on the normal store shelf.
examples.zh: 一位英国药师解释了这种「药房专售药品」为何不在普通货架上。

examples.en: I asked if the label identified the product as a pharmacy-only medicine in this shop.
examples.zh: 我问，这家店的标签是否把这种产品标为「药房专售药品」。

collocations: a pharmacy-only medicine at the counter

words.enDefinition: a medicine prepared by combining or adapting ingredients for a specific need

examples.en: The pharmacy told me when the compounded medication would be ready for collection.
examples.zh: 药房告诉我什么时候可以来领「定制调配药」。

examples.en: I asked whether the leaflet for the compounded medication would be included in the bag.
examples.zh: 我问袋子里会不会附上「定制调配药」的说明书。

words.enDefinition: a mistake in preparing or supplying a prescribed medicine

examples.en: The pharmacy reviewed a possible dispensing error after I reported the mismatched label.
examples.zh: 我报告标签与订单不符后，药房核查了可能的「配药错误」。

examples.en: I asked who would contact me about the dispensing error noted on the order.
examples.zh: 我问，谁会就订单里备注的「配药错误」联系我。

words.enDefinition: the amount a patient is charged when collecting prescription medicine

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist in England what the NHS prescription charge on my receipt covered.
examples.zh: 我问英格兰的药师，收据上的「NHS 处方药收费」包含什么。

examples.en: The website showed the prescription charge separately from the cost of home delivery.
examples.zh: 网站把「处方药收费」和送货上门费分开显示。

words.enDefinition: a status that removes certain charges for prescription medicines

examples.en: The pharmacy in England asked me to confirm my NHS prescription exemption in the portal.
examples.zh: 英格兰的药房请我在系统里确认自己的「NHS 处方费减免资格」。

examples.en: I asked where to check my prescription exemption because I had recently moved.
examples.zh: 我最近搬了家，所以想问在哪里核查我的「处方费减免资格」。

words.enDefinition: a document showing payment or collection for prescription medicine

examples.en: I kept the prescription receipt with the documents for my student insurance claim.
examples.zh: 我把「处方药收据」和学生保险的报销材料放在一起。

examples.en: The name on the prescription receipt was spelled correctly after the clerk updated my profile.
examples.zh: 药房人员更新了我的资料后，「处方药收据」上的姓名拼写就正确了。

words.enDefinition: a refill request that has not yet been completed

examples.en: I opened the pharmacy app to check on the pending refill before leaving campus.
examples.zh: 离开学校前，我打开药房应用查看那笔「待处理的续配」。

examples.en: The pharmacy couldn't see the pending refill until it refreshed the account page.
examples.zh: 药房刷新账户页面后，才看到那笔「待处理的续配」。

collocations: a pending refill in the app

words.enDefinition: a prescription already held in the pharmacy's records

examples.en: The pharmacist said I already had a prescription on file at the campus pharmacy.
examples.zh: 药师说，我在校园药房已有一张「已存档的处方」。

examples.en: I asked whether there was a prescription on file before contacting my clinic again.
examples.zh: 再次联系诊所前，我先问了有没有一张「已存档的处方」。

collocations: check for a prescription on file

words.enDefinition: a U.S. patient handout with required information for certain medicines

examples.en: The pharmacist showed me the Medication Guide that came with my prescription in the US.
examples.zh: 我在美国取药时，药师给我看了随处方药附带的「美国处方药患者指南」。

examples.en: I asked whether the printed Medication Guide was available in another language at that branch.
examples.zh: 我问这家分店有没有其他语言的纸质「美国处方药患者指南」。

collocations: a copy of the Medication Guide

words.enDefinition: a sheet of official product information included inside the packaging

examples.en: Could you show me which part of the package insert lists the ingredients?
examples.zh: 能不能指给我看，「药品包装内附页」的哪一部分列了药品成分？

examples.en: The pharmacist compared the package insert with the brief directions on the outside label.
examples.zh: 药师对照了「药品包装内附页」和外标签上的简要说明。

collocations: a copy of the package insert

words.enDefinition: a closure designed to be harder for young children to open

examples.en: The pharmacist pointed out the child-resistant cap when she showed me the medicine bottle.
examples.zh: 药师给我看药瓶时，指了指上面的「儿童防护瓶盖」。

examples.en: The child-resistant cap on this bottle looked different from the cap on my previous order.
examples.zh: 这瓶药的「儿童防护瓶盖」看起来和上一次拿到的药瓶盖不一样。

collocations: a bottle with a child-resistant cap

words.enDefinition: a seal that shows whether a package has been opened

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist where the tamper-evident seal was on the new bottle.
examples.zh: 我问药师，新药瓶上的「拆封显痕封签」在哪里。

examples.en: The pharmacy checked the tamper-evident seal after I showed them the torn outer carton.
examples.zh: 我拿给药房看破掉的外盒后，他们检查了「拆封显痕封签」。

words.enDefinition: a pack with separate raised pockets to hold individual items

examples.en: The medicine was supplied in a blister pack instead of a small bottle.
examples.zh: 这款药用的是「泡罩包装」，不是小瓶装。

examples.en: I asked the pharmacy whether the blister pack was part of the original packaging.
examples.zh: 我问药房，这个「泡罩包装」是不是原装的一部分。

words.enDefinition: the metal foil layer on the back of a pack

examples.en: I could see the product code printed on the foil backing of each blister pack.
examples.zh: 我看得见每板泡罩包装「背面箔膜」上印着的产品代码。

examples.en: The pharmacist looked at the foil backing to confirm which version was in the box.
examples.zh: 药师看了看「背面箔膜」，确认盒子里装的是哪个版本。

words.enDefinition: a bottle designed to hold solid medicine tablets

examples.en: The pharmacy put the printed label on the front of the tablet bottle.
examples.zh: 药房把打印好的标签贴在了「片剂药瓶」正面。

examples.en: I brought the empty tablet bottle along so the pharmacist could read the old label.
examples.zh: 我带上了空的「片剂药瓶」，方便药师看之前的标签。

words.enDefinition: a divided container for keeping pills organized by time or day

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist which pill organizer had larger labels on its compartments.
examples.zh: 我问药师哪款「分格药盒」的格子标签字号大一点。

examples.en: My roommate found a small pill organizer in the pharmacy section beside the counter.
examples.zh: 我室友在柜台旁边的药房货区找到了一个小「分格药盒」。

words.enDefinition: a needleless device for measuring or delivering liquid by mouth

examples.en: The leaflet showed a picture of the oral syringe supplied with the bottle.
examples.zh: 说明书上印着随瓶附带的「无针口服给药器」的示意图。

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist whether an oral syringe was meant to come with the package.
examples.zh: 我问药师，包装里是不是应该附一支「无针口服给药器」。

collocations: the markings on an oral syringe

words.enDefinition: a small bottle with a device that releases individual drops

examples.en: The package contained a dropper bottle and its separate instruction leaflet in the carton.
examples.zh: 纸盒里有一个「滴管瓶」，还附着一份单独的使用说明书。

examples.en: My pharmacist checked whether the dropper bottle and the outside box had matching numbers.
examples.zh: 药师检查了「滴管瓶」和外盒上的号码是否一致。

words.enDefinition: a small container intended to be used on one occasion

examples.en: The printed diagram showed what a single-use vial looked like inside the box.
examples.zh: 印出来的图示展示了盒中「一次性小药瓶」的样子。

examples.en: I checked whether each single-use vial was marked with the same product name.
examples.zh: 我查看了每个「一次性小药瓶」上标的产品名称是不是一样。

collocations: each single-use vial in the box

words.enDefinition: the outer cardboard package surrounding the medicine and its leaflet

examples.en: The pharmacy asked me to bring the outer carton with the product code visible.
examples.zh: 药房请我带上「药品外盒」，让他们看得清产品代码。

examples.en: I kept the outer carton because it had information absent from the small bottle label.
examples.zh: 我留着「药品外盒」，因为小瓶的标签上没有印外盒上的一些信息。

words.enDefinition: a small pharmacy container used to supply prescription medicine

examples.en: The clerk checked the label printed on my prescription vial before handing over the bag.
examples.zh: 药房人员核对了「处方药分装瓶」上的标签，才把袋子交给我。

examples.en: My pharmacist showed me where to find the pharmacy phone number on the prescription vial.
examples.zh: 药师给我指了「处方药分装瓶」上药房联系电话的位置。

words.enDefinition: the amount or number of items contained in a pack

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist which package size matched the order on the screen.
examples.zh: 我问药师哪种「包装规格」和屏幕上的订单相符。

examples.en: The package size was printed in small lettering near the bottom of the box.
examples.zh: 「包装规格」用小字印在盒子靠下的位置。

collocations: print the package size on the label

words.enDefinition: a code identifying a group of products made together

examples.en: The pharmacist asked for the lot number printed on the side of the carton.
examples.zh: 药师让我提供纸盒侧面印着的「生产批号」。

examples.en: I couldn't read the lot number on the tiny label without my reading glasses.
examples.zh: 那张小标签上的「生产批号」，我不戴眼镜就看不清。

words.enDefinition: written information describing how a product should be kept

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist to go over the storage instructions in the folded leaflet.
examples.zh: 我请药师讲解折叠说明书里的「储存说明」。

examples.en: The storage instructions were printed beside a small box headed other information.
examples.zh: 「储存说明」印在标题为其他信息的小方框旁边。

collocations: follow the storage instructions on the label

words.enDefinition: a label identifying something that needs refrigerated storage

examples.en: The pharmacy bag had a refrigeration label, so I asked what it referred to.
examples.zh: 药袋上有「冷藏标识」，我就问它指的是哪样东西。

examples.en: I showed the pharmacist the refrigeration label because I could not read its small print.
examples.zh: 「冷藏标识」字太小，我看不清，就拿给药师看。

words.enDefinition: a solid compressed medicine formulated for use by mouth

examples.en: I asked whether the prescription specified an oral tablet or a liquid medicine.
examples.zh: 我问这张处方注明的是「口服片剂」还是液体药。

examples.en: The pharmacy's database showed an oral tablet next to the medicine name.
examples.zh: 药房的数据库在药名旁边标注了「口服片剂」。

words.enDefinition: a medicine tablet designed to be chewed before swallowing

examples.en: The pharmacist pointed to the words chewable tablet on the new label.
examples.zh: 药师指了指新标签上写的「咀嚼片」字样。

examples.en: I asked whether the picture in the leaflet showed a chewable tablet.
examples.zh: 我问说明书的图片上画的是不是「咀嚼片」。

words.enDefinition: a tablet that fizzes and dissolves when placed in water

examples.en: The pharmacist explained what effervescent tablet meant on the side of the tube.
examples.zh: 药师解释了管装药侧面写的「泡腾片」是什么意思。

examples.en: The package said effervescent tablet in much larger letters than the brand name.
examples.zh: 包装上「泡腾片」的字比品牌名字大得多。

words.enDefinition: a tablet designed to disintegrate quickly in the mouth

examples.en: My pharmacist showed me which wording identified this as an orodispersible tablet.
examples.zh: 药师给我指了包装上哪些字样表明这是「口崩片」。

examples.en: The leaflet listed an orodispersible tablet separately from the standard version of the medicine.
examples.zh: 说明书把「口崩片」和这种药的普通版本分别列出。

words.enDefinition: a medicine tablet designed to dissolve under the tongue

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist to explain the term sublingual tablet on the leaflet.
examples.zh: 我请药师解释说明书里的「舌下片」是什么意思。

examples.en: The label described it as a sublingual tablet, which was unfamiliar to me.
examples.zh: 标签写的是「舌下片」，这个词我之前没见过。

words.enDefinition: a tablet with a coating designed to resist stomach acid

examples.en: The pharmacist explained that enteric-coated tablet described the formulation shown on this package.
examples.zh: 药师解释说，「肠溶片」指的是这个包装上注明的剂型。

examples.en: I checked that the words enteric-coated tablet matched the entry on my list.
examples.zh: 我核查了「肠溶片」几个字是否与清单里的记录一致。

words.enDefinition: a tablet designed to release its medicine gradually over time

examples.en: I asked which abbreviation on the box stood for extended-release tablet in the leaflet.
examples.zh: 我问盒子上哪个缩写对应说明书里的「缓释片」。

examples.en: The pharmacist identified the extended-release tablet in the photograph of my old package.
examples.zh: 药师从我旧包装的照片上认出了「缓释片」。

words.enDefinition: a tablet without a design that delays release of its medicine

examples.en: The pharmacist compared the immediate-release tablet label with the older version in the system.
examples.zh: 药师把「速释片」的标签与系统里的旧版本作了对照。

examples.en: I asked where the leaflet described the immediate-release tablet form of this product.
examples.zh: 我问说明书哪里介绍了这款药的「速释片」剂型。

words.enDefinition: a medicine tablet with a groove across its surface

examples.en: The package contained a scored tablet shown in the small diagram on the leaflet.
examples.zh: 包装里的「带刻痕片剂」在说明书的小图上有展示。

examples.en: The pharmacist recognized the scored tablet when I showed her the package photograph.
examples.zh: 我把包装照片给药师看，她认出了「带刻痕片剂」。

collocations: a picture of a scored tablet

words.enDefinition: a small shell that contains medicine in solid or liquid form

examples.en: I asked whether the order on the screen showed a capsule formulation.
examples.zh: 我问屏幕上的订单是不是写了「胶囊」剂型。

examples.en: The leaflet included a picture of a capsule next to its product name.
examples.zh: 说明书在产品名称旁边印了一张「胶囊」的图。

words.enDefinition: a flexible sealed capsule usually containing liquid or oil

examples.en: The label used softgel in the description, so I asked what it meant.
examples.zh: 标签介绍用了「软胶囊」这个词，我就问是什么意思。

examples.en: The pharmacist checked whether the carton for the softgel matched the prescription.
examples.zh: 药师核对了「软胶囊」的外盒是否和处方一致。

words.enDefinition: a small solid preparation designed to dissolve slowly in the mouth

examples.en: The leaflet used the word lozenge rather than tablet on the front page.
examples.zh: 说明书首页用的是「含片」这个词，没有写片剂。

examples.en: I showed the pharmacist the lozenge packaging because the name was hard to read.
examples.zh: 药名太难看清，我就把「含片」的包装拿给药师看。

words.enDefinition: a liquid medicine with its ingredients dissolved for use by mouth

examples.en: The prescription listed an oral solution with a product name I hadn't seen before.
examples.zh: 处方上列了一种「口服溶液」，产品名我以前没见过。

examples.en: The pharmacist pointed to oral solution on the bottle so I could distinguish the packages.
examples.zh: 药师指出瓶上写的「口服溶液」，让我能分辨这几种包装。

words.enDefinition: a liquid for oral use with undissolved solid particles dispersed throughout

examples.en: The pharmacist explained the words oral suspension as she pointed at the bottle.
examples.zh: 药师指着瓶子，给我解释了「口服混悬液」这几个字。

examples.en: I asked whether the oral suspension was the item listed on the clinic's note.
examples.zh: 我问这瓶「口服混悬液」是不是诊所便条上列的那种药。

words.enDefinition: a sweet liquid preparation used as a form of medicine

examples.en: The pharmacist said the bottle was a syrup, which the label also showed.
examples.zh: 药师说瓶里是「糖浆剂」，标签上也标着。

examples.en: The pharmacy compared the syrup label with the product photo in its system.
examples.zh: 药房把「糖浆剂」的标签和系统里的产品照片作了对照。

words.enDefinition: a semisolid medicine in cream form for application to the skin

examples.en: The pharmacist underlined the words topical cream on the printed order for me.
examples.zh: 药师在打印出来的处方上给我划出了「外用乳膏」几个字。

examples.en: The carton for the topical cream looked similar to another package on the pharmacy shelf.
examples.zh: 「外用乳膏」的外盒和药房货架上的另一个包装很像。

words.enDefinition: a thick semisolid preparation used on the skin or another surface

examples.en: I asked whether the ointment in the photograph was the one listed on my receipt.
examples.zh: 我问照片里的「软膏」是不是收据上列的那一种。

examples.en: The pharmacist pointed out where the carton said ointment in smaller print.
examples.zh: 药师给我指了外盒上用小字印着「软膏」的地方。

words.enDefinition: a liquid medicine packaged for delivery in drops into the eye

examples.en: The print was small, so I checked the eye drops label with the pharmacist.
examples.zh: 标签字太小，我就和药师一起核对了「滴眼液」的标签。

examples.en: I asked if the eye drops box included a leaflet with larger print.
examples.zh: 我问「滴眼液」盒里有没有字号更大的说明书。

words.enDefinition: a liquid preparation packaged for delivery in drops into the ear

examples.en: The pharmacist showed me the word ear on the ear drops box.
examples.zh: 药师给我指了「滴耳液」盒子上标的 ear 一词。

examples.en: I took the ear drops package to the counter to ask about its label.
examples.zh: 我把「滴耳液」包装拿到柜台，想问标签上的内容。

collocations: a sealed box of ear drops

words.enDefinition: a liquid or powder preparation delivered as a spray into the nose

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist which number on the nasal spray box was the lot number.
examples.zh: 我问药师，「鼻喷剂」盒子上的哪个号码是生产批号。

examples.en: The nasal spray carton was smaller than the one shown in the pharmacy's photograph.
examples.zh: 「鼻喷剂」的外盒比药房照片上那盒小。

words.enDefinition: a device that delivers medicine in a form breathed in

examples.en: I brought my old inhaler package so the pharmacist could check the exact model.
examples.zh: 我带去了旧的「吸入器」包装，方便药师核对具体型号。

examples.en: The leaflet included a labeled drawing of the inhaler next to the contents list.
examples.zh: 说明书在内装物品清单旁印了带标注的「吸入器」示意图。

words.enDefinition: a patch designed to release medicine through the skin

examples.en: The pharmacist showed me where the outer box said transdermal patch in bold.
examples.zh: 药师给我指了外盒上用粗体印着「透皮贴剂」的地方。

examples.en: The leaflet listed the transdermal patch separately from the other formulations on the page.
examples.zh: 说明书把「透皮贴剂」和页面上的其他剂型分别列出。

words.enDefinition: a solid medicine form designed to dissolve inside a body opening

examples.en: I asked what the word suppository meant on the clinic's printed order.
examples.zh: 我问诊所打印出的处方上，「栓剂」这个词是什么意思。

examples.en: The label showed a small picture of a suppository next to the product name.
examples.zh: 标签在产品名旁边印了一张「栓剂」的小图。

words.enDefinition: a small sealed wrapper filled with a powdered preparation

examples.en: The manufacturer printed the product name on each powder sachet inside the box.
examples.zh: 生产商在盒内每个「粉剂小袋」上都印了产品名。

examples.en: I took a powder sachet to the counter so the pharmacist could identify it.
examples.zh: 我拿了一包「粉剂小袋」到柜台，请药师帮我确认里面是什么。

words.enDefinition: a packet containing medicine packaged separately as one labeled dose

examples.en: The pharmacist pointed out the product name on each unit-dose packet in the carton.
examples.zh: 药师给我指出了盒里每个「单剂量包装袋」上的产品名称。

examples.en: The photograph in the leaflet showed the back of a single unit-dose packet.
examples.zh: 说明书里的照片展示了一个「单剂量包装袋」的背面。

words.enDefinition: the physical form in which a medicine is supplied

examples.en: I asked which dosage form appeared next to the medicine name in the app.
examples.zh: 我问应用里药名旁边写的是哪一种「药品剂型」。

examples.en: The pharmacist checked the dosage form before giving me the printed copy of the order.
examples.zh: 药师核对了「药品剂型」，才把打印出来的处方副本交给我。

words.enDefinition: the amount per unit or concentration of the active ingredient

examples.en: I couldn't tell which number described the medication strength, so I asked the pharmacist.
examples.zh: 我分不清哪个数字表示「药品含量规格」，于是问了药师。

examples.en: The medication strength appeared below the formulation name on the pharmacy's computer screen.
examples.zh: 药房电脑屏幕上的「药品含量规格」显示在剂型名称下方。

words.enDefinition: written information explaining how a particular product is intended to be used

examples.en: I asked where the directions for use were printed on the back of the carton.
examples.zh: 我问「使用说明」印在纸盒背面的什么位置。

examples.en: The pharmacist read the directions for use aloud because the leaflet's print was very small.
examples.zh: 说明书的字太小，药师把「使用说明」读给我听。

collocations: the directions for use on the package

words.enDefinition: a label drawing attention to a possible risk or restriction

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist to explain the symbol on the warning label.
examples.zh: 我请药师解释「警示标签」上的符号。

examples.en: The warning label was printed in black lettering near the bottom of the carton.
examples.zh: 「警示标签」用黑字印在纸盒靠近底部的位置。

words.enDefinition: a notice that a product may contain a particular allergen

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist where to find the allergen warning on the medicine leaflet.
examples.zh: 我问药师，药品说明书上的「过敏原提示」在哪里。

examples.en: The shop printed the allergen warning beneath the list of inactive ingredients.
examples.zh: 药房把「过敏原提示」印在非活性成分列表下方。

collocations: an allergen warning on the label

words.enDefinition: unwanted effects that a medicine may cause in some people

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist where possible side effects were listed in the longer leaflet.
examples.zh: 我问药师，较长的那份说明书在哪里列了「可能的副作用」。

examples.en: The app linked to a section about possible side effects on the manufacturer's website.
examples.zh: 应用链接到了生产商网站上关于「可能的副作用」的内容。

collocations: a section on possible side effects

words.enDefinition: a change in how a medicine acts because of another substance

examples.en: I saw the words drug interaction on the printout and asked what they meant.
examples.zh: 我在打印件上看到「药物相互作用」几个字，就问是什么意思。

examples.en: The pharmacist checked the note about a potential drug interaction before preparing my order.
examples.zh: 药师配药前查看了关于潜在「药物相互作用」的备注。

words.enDefinition: a condition or circumstance making a medicine unsuitable to use

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist to explain the word contraindication in the patient leaflet.
examples.zh: 我请药师解释患者用药说明书里「禁忌证」这个词。

examples.en: The leaflet listed a contraindication under a heading I hadn't noticed before.
examples.zh: 说明书把一项「禁忌证」列在我之前没有注意到的小标题下面。

words.enDefinition: the name used to identify a specific medicine

examples.en: I asked the pharmacy to check the drug name printed beside the order number.
examples.zh: 我请药房核对印在订单号旁边的「药品名称」。

examples.en: The drug name was easier to read in the app than on the tiny sticker.
examples.zh: 应用里的「药品名称」比那张小贴纸上印的更容易看清。

words.enDefinition: instructions written with everyday words instead of technical language

examples.en: I asked whether the pharmacy had plain-language instructions that I could take home.
examples.zh: 我问药房有没有可以带回去看的「通俗版说明」。

examples.en: The pharmacist offered plain-language instructions after I said the leaflet was hard to follow.
examples.zh: 我说说明书看不太懂，药师就提出可以提供「通俗版说明」。

words.enDefinition: getting rid of medicines that are unwanted, unused, or expired

examples.en: I asked the pharmacy whether its medicine disposal service was available on Saturdays.
examples.zh: 我问药房的「废弃药品处理」服务星期六开不开。

examples.en: The clinic website had a page about medicine disposal that listed local drop-off locations.
examples.zh: 诊所网站有一页介绍「废弃药品处理」，列了本地的回收点。

words.enDefinition: a service collecting unwanted medicines for appropriate disposal

examples.en: My pharmacy showed me a leaflet about the local take-back program in our neighborhood.
examples.zh: 药房给我看了一份介绍我们社区「废药回收计划」的宣传单。

examples.en: I asked whether the take-back program operated during normal opening hours at this branch.
examples.zh: 我问这个分店的「废药回收计划」是否在正常营业时间开展。

words.enDefinition: the removal or correction of an affected medicine or batch

examples.en: I called the pharmacy to ask whether the medicine recall affected my earlier order.
examples.zh: 我给药房打电话，问这次「药品召回」是否涉及我之前的订单。

examples.en: The notice about the medicine recall listed several product codes and a contact number.
examples.zh: 「药品召回」公告列了几个产品代码和一个联系电话。

words.enDefinition: a product container that has not yet been opened

examples.en: The pharmacist asked me to bring the unopened package so she could compare its label.
examples.zh: 药师请我带上「未拆封的包装」，方便她比对标签。

examples.en: I could see two different product numbers printed on the same unopened package.
examples.zh: 我看得见同一个「未拆封的包装」上印着两个不同的产品编号。

words.enDefinition: packaging with damage such as a tear, split, or dent

examples.en: I took the damaged packaging to the counter because the label was partly torn.
examples.zh: 标签有一部分撕破了，我把「受损的包装」拿到了柜台。

examples.en: The clerk photographed the damaged packaging and recorded the product number in the system.
examples.zh: 药房人员给「受损的包装」拍了照，把产品编号记进系统。

words.enDefinition: a pad of blank forms for writing medicine orders

examples.en: The clinician used a prescription pad while the computer system was temporarily offline.
examples.zh: 电脑系统暂时离线时，医生用了一本「处方笺本」。

examples.en: I recognized the clinic name printed across the top of the prescription pad.
examples.zh: 我认出了「处方笺本」顶部印着的诊所名称。

words.enDefinition: a code or document allowing a pharmacy to retrieve an electronic prescription

examples.en: My clinic in Australia sent a prescription token by text after the appointment.
examples.zh: 在澳大利亚看诊后，诊所发短信给我一个「电子处方凭证」。

examples.en: The pharmacy asked me to show the prescription token on my phone screen.
examples.zh: 药房请我出示手机屏幕上的「电子处方凭证」。

words.enDefinition: a reference code used to verify a specific pickup

examples.en: The system sent me a collection code when my order was ready.
examples.zh: 订单备好后，系统给我发了一个「取药核验码」。

examples.en: I showed the collection code to the clerk because the app wouldn't load.
examples.zh: 应用加载不出来，我就把「取药核验码」出示给了药房人员。

collocations: a text with a collection code

words.enDefinition: the process of checking the current status of a prescription order

examples.en: The pharmacy added prescription tracking to its app, which I check before visiting.
examples.zh: 药房应用加了「处方配药进度查询」，我到店之前会先看一下。

examples.en: I asked whether prescription tracking worked for orders sent from the campus clinic.
examples.zh: 我问校园诊所发的订单能不能用「处方配药进度查询」。

words.enDefinition: the date on which a pharmacy supplied a prescribed medicine

examples.en: My pharmacist asked for the fill date printed on the old label.
examples.zh: 药师请我提供旧标签上印着的「配药日期」。

examples.en: The receipt showed a fill date next to the pharmacy's order number.
examples.zh: 收据上药房订单编号旁边写着「配药日期」。

words.enDefinition: a record of medicines a pharmacy has previously supplied

examples.en: I asked the pharmacy to send me a copy of my dispensing history.
examples.zh: 我请药房发给我一份「历次配药记录」的副本。

examples.en: The pharmacist looked at my dispensing history to find last autumn's order.
examples.zh: 药师查了我的「历次配药记录」，找出去年秋天的订单。

collocations: request a copy of the dispensing history

words.enDefinition: a notice prompting a patient to request another supply

examples.en: I received a refill reminder while I was using the library computers.
examples.zh: 我在用图书馆的电脑时，收到了一条「续配提醒」。

examples.en: The pharmacy asked whether I wanted a refill reminder sent by email.
examples.zh: 药房问我想不想通过电子邮件接收「续配提醒」。

words.enDefinition: a situation in which available medicine supplies cannot meet demand

examples.en: The pharmacy gave me the clinic's number when it mentioned a drug shortage.
examples.zh: 药房提到「药品短缺」时，把诊所电话号码给了我。

examples.en: I asked whether the drug shortage was listed on the health department website.
examples.zh: 我问卫生部门网站上有没有列出这次「药品短缺」。

words.enDefinition: a check for whether a product is currently available

examples.en: The pharmacist ran a stock check before saying when I could collect the order.
examples.zh: 药师做了「库存查询」之后，才告诉我什么时候可以来取药。

examples.en: I phoned the other branch and asked for a stock check before walking over.
examples.zh: 走过去之前，我打电话到另一家分店，请他们做一下「库存查询」。

words.enDefinition: a secondary pharmacy label adding information to the main one

examples.en: The pharmacist pointed out the auxiliary label next to the main label.
examples.zh: 药师指了指主标签旁边的「附加药品标签」。

examples.en: I asked about a symbol printed on the small auxiliary label by the lid.
examples.zh: 我问瓶盖旁那张小小的「附加药品标签」上印的符号是什么意思。

collocations: an auxiliary label on a bottle

words.enDefinition: the time needed for a pharmacy to prepare an order

examples.en: I asked about the prescription processing time before deciding when to walk back from campus.
examples.zh: 决定什么时候从学校走回来前，我问了「处方配药处理时长」。

examples.en: The pharmacy's app showed a longer prescription processing time during the holiday weekend.
examples.zh: 假期周末，药房应用显示的「处方配药处理时长」更长。

words.enDefinition: the stage an order has reached in the pharmacy system

examples.en: The prescription status changed after the pharmacy received a reply from my clinic.
examples.zh: 药房收到诊所的回复后，「处方处理状态」变了。

examples.en: I asked where the app displayed the prescription status while waiting near campus.
examples.zh: 在学校附近等待时，我问应用在哪里显示「处方处理状态」。

words.enDefinition: available to be collected at the designated location

examples.en: The pharmacy texted that my order was ready for pickup just after my tutorial.
examples.zh: 辅导课刚结束，药房就发短信说我的订单「可以领取」了。

examples.en: The clerk checked the system to confirm my prescription was ready for pickup.
examples.zh: 药房人员查了系统，确认我的处方药「可以领取」。

collocations: notify someone it's ready for pickup

words.enDefinition: a closure designed to open with less effort

examples.en: I asked the pharmacist whether the bottle in the display had an easy-open cap.
examples.zh: 我问药师，展示区里的那个瓶子有没有「易开瓶盖」。

examples.en: The easy-open cap looked different from the other bottle cap in the pharmacy display.
examples.zh: 「易开瓶盖」和药房展示区的另一种瓶盖看起来不一样。

collocations: a bottle with an easy-open cap
